system.description:
Secret (a dragon egg). It wakes only to dragonfire or a dragons' fight within a mile.

Study: 12 weeks of tending, a Wisdom check, DC 15; it hatches as a wyrmling of a colour the GM chooses, is young after 5 years and an adult only after centuries.

  • It is not a creation: the GM runs it.
  • It stays while you feed it and treat it well, expects a tenth of every hoard you win, and refuses orders it dislikes.
  • Laid before the Shattering and never hatched.
  • It stirs whenever dragons fight nearby.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
